name: facebook_check_mentions
description: Check Facebook Page for new mentions and engagement. Use this when you need to monitor your Facebook Page for mentions, comments, or activity that may require a response.

since_hours.description: Check mentions from the last N hours (default: 24)

vault_path.description: Path to AI Employee Vault for action file creation (default: 'AI_Employee_Vault')

create_action_files.description: Whether to create .md action files in Needs_Action/ folder (default: true)
